Excalidraw, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the ~191 custom properties excalidraw.com's stylesheet declares on .excalidraw — the gray ramp, the brand and semantic colour roles, the per-component --button-*/--island-*/--sidebar-*/ExcTextField/RadioGroup/Switch vars, the --shadow-* elevations, the --zIndex-* paint order, radii, sizes and spacing — plus the geometry measured on the running editor. Dark is the app's own Theme radio: the stylesheet overrides ~80 of the vars under .excalidraw.theme--dark. The toggle in the header sets data-mode on <html> the same way. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from excalidraw.com on 2026-11-14, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 × 900 (mobile 390 × 844). Assistant, Excalifont and Cascadia are served from Excalidraw's CDN and are not loaded here: the UI falls back to the system sans, the hand-drawn face to a casual cursive, the mono to ui-monospace.

Colour

Excalidraw names colours by role. color.brand is the violet primary ramp, color.surface the four-step ground (lowest to high), color.text the ink, color.border the hairlines, then the muted, status (success/warning/danger), icon, link, popup and control families. The control.* set holds the per-component roles — buttons, islands, the sidebar, fields, the radio group, the switch. Each swatch shows the active theme's value; flip the header toggle to compare — dark keeps the same names and rebinds most of them.

Ramps

One shared gray ramp, 10 (near-white) to 100 (near-black), declared once on .excalidraw and never overridden — dark rebinds the roles that point into it instead of owning a second ramp. The brand violet is declared per theme: #6965db in light, a lighter #a8a5ff in dark.

Typography

One family does all the UI work: Assistant at a handful of sizes (the logo/heading/hint rows below are measured on the welcome screen, menus and controls). Excalifont is the hand-drawn face — the welcome wordmark and the default canvas handwriting. Cascadia covers code elements and keybindings.

Space, size and shape

Spacing is a declared scale — the 0.25rem --space-factor and the shell paddings — plus a named size scale for controls: 32px buttons, the 36px toolbar controls, 16–20px icons, the 20px switch thumb. The component.* bars are measured geometry: the 44px tool island, 36px tool buttons, the 195px properties panel and the 294px library.

Radius

Elevation

Soft, low-contrast lifts declared as --shadow-*: the island shadow carries every floating toolbar and dropdown (a hairline plus a gentle blur), the modal shadow the dialogs, the sidebar shadow the panels. All are theme-invariant.

Motion

Quiet and quick: control states ease over ~150 ms (transitionDuration measured on the tool buttons and menu rows). Click a track to play it.

Layout

One fixed-height canvas app at 1440 × 900: floating Islands over the canvas — the hamburger top-left, the 44px tool island centred top, Share/Plus actions top-right, zoom and undo bottom-left, help bottom-right. A shape tool summons the 195px properties panel on the left; the library trigger opens the 294px sidebar on the right.
